dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.message:
Operations hub for real-time monitoring of hardware status and service workflows.

• Track high-level metrics for open tickets, supply levels, and device health.
• Switch databases or facilities seamlessly if you support multiple sites.
• Use your workshop code to sync data and collaborate with colleagues.

printers.title: Printers
printers.message:
Central catalog and registry for all printing hardware across your organization.

• Register devices with assigned rooms, models, and hardware serial numbers.
• Always verify the "Brand" field — it dictates available model selections.
• Deduct parts directly via "History" or send retired devices to the archive.

rooms.title: Locations
rooms.message:
Directory of physical sites: offices, rooms, server hubs, and supply closets.

• Define locations to map hardware placement and allocate consumable inventory.
• Identify device positions instantly when a service ticket is raised.
• Filter your entire hardware fleet by specific rooms and departments.

parts.title: Parts & Supplies
parts.message:
Warehouse inventory system for replacement parts, toners, and maintenance kits.

• Track incoming stock and monitor minimum thresholds for toners and rollers.
• Select the correct "Brand" to enable precise compatibility matching during repairs.
• Link parts directly to printer models for one-tap service deductions.

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.message:
Engineering guide for service manuals, teardowns, and diagnostic trouble codes.

• Store step-by-step disassembly guides, cartridge refilling steps, and error fixes.
• Tag articles by equipment brand and model for instant searching.
• Access verified technical solutions right at the customer workstation.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.message:
Work order planner for dispatched repairs, preventive checks, and service tickets.

• Create work orders, schedule deadlines, and log technical field notes.
• Resolve tickets in one click with automatic inventory deductions from stock.
• Complete inspections and preventative servicing without writing off parts.
